 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Ghastly"** means something that is shockingly frightful or dreadful; it can also refer to something extremely unpleasant or bad. (भयानक)

 
 
• **Example: **The haunted house was filled with** ghastly **images that terrified the visitors.
 
 
 
• **"Pleasant" **refers to something that is agreeable, enjoyable, or giving a sense of happy satisfaction or enjoyment. (सुखद)
 
 
• **Example: **We had a **pleasant** afternoon picnic in the park.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Ghastly' **is **'Pleasant'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Agitated **(बेचैन): Feeling or appearing troubled or nervous.

 
 
• **Example:** She became agitated when she couldn't find her keys.
 
 
 
• **Relaxing **(आरामदायक): Making someone feel relaxed; reducing tension or anxiety.
 
 
• **Example: **A relaxing bath can help you unwind after a long day.
 
 
 
• **Bitter **(कड़वा): Having a sharp, pungent taste or smell; not sweet.
 
 
• **Example:** The medicine had a bitter taste.
